mapper.select: SELECT room_id AS roomId, department_id AS departmentId, room_number AS roomNumber, room_type AS roomType, capacity, location, status, remark FROM consulting_room ORDER BY room_number ASC
SELECT room_id AS roomId, department_id AS departmentId, room_number AS roomNumber, room_type AS roomType, capacity, location, status, remark FROM consulting_room WHERE room_id = #{roomId}

SELECT room_id AS roomId, department_id AS departmentId, room_number AS roomNumber, room_type AS roomType, capacity, location, status, remark FROM consulting_room WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY room_number ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consulting_room( department_id, room_number, room_type, capacity, location, status, remark ) VALUES( #{departmentId}, #{roomNumber}, #{roomType}, #{capacity}, #{location}, #{status}, #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE consulting_room SET department_id = #{departmentId}, room_number = #{roomNumber}, room_type = #{roomType}, capacity = #{capacity}, location = #{location}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark} WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
